summary: Admin Settings page testing completed. Backend APIs all pass (15/15 tests). Frontend UI functional with one minor error handling issue.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend shows 'Failed to connect to server' instead of the actual API error message 'Current password is incorrect'. The catch block in handlePasswordChange masks the actual 400 response error.

action_items: Consider improving error handling in AdminSettings.jsx handlePasswordChange function to properly display API error messages from non-200 responses rather than falling into generic catch block message
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend error handling in handlePasswordChange could be improved - the catch block shows generic 'Failed to connect to server' even when API returns proper 400 error with message

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all features work, minor error message display issue)
